'''Miedelle Caeren''' was wife of [[Nasin Caeren]].

==History==
Lady Miedelle died in {{ne|970}}. Her husband, Nasin, thought of Miedelle as [[Arymilla Marne]]'s mother, though they are unrelated.{{ref/book|10|15}}
